summary: NOVONIX Ltd filed a Form 6-K on May 1, 2026, disclosing the completion of the sale of its NOVONIX Battery Technology Solutions (BTS) business to former CEO Dr. Chris Burns. The transaction involved a sale price of US$1.00, with NOVONIX receiving a 15% equity stake in the cathode business (Dryve Battery Materials Inc.). BTS held US$2M cash at close. NOVONIX will provide transition services and a trademark license through December 31, 2026. The divestiture is part of a strategy to focus on synthetic graphite. No board recommendation or advisor was mentioned. The deal has closed; watch for execution of transition services and any updates on the cathode commercialization.
